text: In the winter of 1996, a French dance troupe finishes days of rehearsal in an abandoned school and [celebrates with an after-party|trigger|a special occasion], drinking sangria while DJ Daddy plays. Slowly the dancers realise [the sangria has been spiked|threat|sickness and poison], and suspicion turns to cruelty as [they throw one man out into the snowstorm|rules|people turn on each other] and kick a pregnant dancer in the stomach. Emmanuelle locks [her young son Tito|who_suffers|young children] in an electrical room to keep him safe, then loses the key.
